title: ESIC Kollam Recruitment 2026 – Specialist, Senior Residents and More Posts (Walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: ESIC Kollam has announced notification for Specialist, Senior Residents and More Posts (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: MS/MD, MBBS, BDS, DNB. Last date to apply: 03-09-26.
howToApply: Candidates must appear for the Walk-in Interview on 03.09.2026 (Thursday) at ESIC Model and Super Speciality Hospital, Asramam, Kollam, Kerala.
Registration is from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM near the Medical Superintendent’s Room.
Bring the application in the prescribed proforma (Annexure 1) filled in capital letters.
Carry all original documents including educational certificates, experience certificates, caste certificate (if applicable), MCI/Dental Council registration certificate, and date of birth proof.
Bring one set of Xerox copies of all original documents.
Bring two recent passport size photographs (one affixed on the application).
Pay the requisite application fee via Demand Draft drawn in favour of ‘Employees’ State Insurance Fund – Account No 1′ payable at Kollam.
OBC/SC/ST candidates must produce valid caste certificate issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer. OBC certificate must certify non-creamy layer status.
EWS certificate must be valid and issued by Tahasildar/Revenue Divisional Officer in prescribed form.
PWD candidates must possess disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of State or Central Government Hospitals/Institutions.
Candidates working in Central/State Government institutions must obtain and submit NOC from the concerned authority.
Candidates who have already completed Senior Residency for 3 years in any Central Institution are not eligible for the post of Senior Resident.
Detailed notification and instructions are available at https://www.esic.gov.in/recruitments

title: CSL Recruitment 2026 – Graduate Apprentices (Category I), Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Category II) Posts
shortInfo: CSL has announced notification for Graduate Apprentices (Category I), Technician (Diploma) Apprentices (Category II) posts. Required qualification: Degree in Engineering/Technology, Diploma in Engineering/Technology. Last date to apply: 01-09-26.
howToApply: Visit the NATS portal at https://nats.education.gov.in.

If already registered on old portal (portal.mhrdnats.gov.in): Activate your account on the new portal using the ‘Forgot Password’ option at the student login page. Login and complete the application form ensuring all details are correct. Then search for ‘COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED’ under ‘Apply against advertised vacancies’ and click Apply.

If not registered on old portal: Go to https://nats.education.gov.in, click ‘Student’, then ‘Student Register’, complete the application form, and note the unique Enrolment Number generated. Then login, search for ‘COCHIN SHIPYARD LIMITED’ under ‘Apply against advertised vacancies’, and click Apply.
Ensure all marks and details are entered correctly before submission.
For issues/queries related to NATS portal, contact Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT), Southern Region, Chennai via email: studentquery@boatsrp.com.
Online application window: 12.08.2026 to 01.09.2026.
